Who creates light was because the time for the recitation of: … Who creates light, … had not yet arrived, … However, … when the time … Who creates light arrived, … they would recite it. … Shema

Who creates light was because the time for the recitation of: Who creates light, had not yet arrived, as the sun had yet to rise. The blessings of the priestly watch are recited in the early morning hours, long before sunrise. However, afterward, when the time to recite: Who creates light arrived, they would recite it.
